message.text: We are a 30-person branding and video studio. Our delivery runs on about 20 freelancers and every project handover is a mess of Notion pages and WhatsApp threads. I want this fixed before we take on two new retainers in November. Budget is approved. Please send me your availability for a 30-minute call.
message.subject: Freelancer handovers
